Generated by `npm run codemap` from docs/codemap/jobs.json and the source. Do not edit by hand. The maps carry no line counts (the 450-line limit is enforced by the size check).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `index.js` | The one entry SillyTavern loads: starts the host and its built-in modules (the people part last), then the view. | — | `core/boot/boot.js`<br>`ui/entry/start.js` | — | — |

| `ui/css/bag.css` | Styles for the Bag tab: Purse and load, Assets, item grid and sheets; tokens, plus the mock's fixed tints and rarity borders in both themes, layout follows the container. Every rule is scoped to .bag-tab or .bag-sheet so no other tab is touched. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/base.css` | Base styles: reset, font and focus rules for everything inside the suite root. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/card.css` | Character card styles (decisions 19-21): tokens renamed from --g-* to --su-*. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/chat.css` | The card under each story reply, the reply sheet and the modules' cards: SillyTavern theme variables only, never the suite tokens (decision 34). | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/dossier-map.css` | Styles for the dossier's phone top bar (two lines), its library strip (folded, open, a grid on a phone) and its Map tab (the relationship map with the picked person beside or under it). | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/dossier.css` | Styles for the dossier: always the flat surface; top bar, portrait column, cards, the opened part (beside the cards from 1,080 px, a page below) and the part bodies, sized from the suite window. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/drawer.css` | The Story Suite drawer in SillyTavern's Extensions panel: its status line and button row. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/fight.css` | Styles for the Fight tab: header, foes, party, action tiles, log and end card; tokens only, sized from the container. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/fonts.css` | The bundled Nunito font faces the view's stylesheets name. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/gear-stats.css` | Gear Stats picker styles (Bag + Add, the item sheet's and the Party slot sheet's Change): the frame around the Party stat sheet's .ps-st rows, the fixed Rarity and the note line. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/journal.css` | Styles for the Journal tab: quest cards, leads, closed list, calendar, day panel, coming up and the edit form; tokens, plus the mock's fixed tints and text colours in both themes. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/kit.css` | Kit styles: the one button, chip, switch and segmented-control family, sized for touch. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/loot.css` | Loot to pick up: under the newest reply's card (SillyTavern theme variables, opened by its action line's Pick up) and on the Bag's To pick up card (suite tokens, mock v7 .chips3 and .btn2). | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/now.css` | Styles for the Now tab cards, the Show-all list, the spoiler switch and the feelings ring; tokens, plus the mock's fixed late, fight, torn, ring and tracker-bar tones and its per-scheme feeling colours. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/party.css` | Party tab styles (decision 22, party.html): member row, sheet, equipment doll, stats, skills and the bottom sheets; tokens, plus the mock's fixed stance, rarity, mastery and scrim colours in both themes. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/people.css` | Styles for the People tab: tiles, filters, search and the cast map; tokens plus the mock's fixed disc and legend colours. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/scene.css` | Styles for the Scene tab (the open interaction): header, the generic renderer's lines and choices, Send and Discard; tokens only, sized from the container. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/settings.css` | Settings overlay styles: frame, section nav, rows and controls, search, footer meter (decision 33; tokens renamed --g-* to --su-*). | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/sheet-desk.css` | Desktop sheet frame: from a 1100 px suite root every sheet but the wizard is a centred 640 px panel over a full-window dim, head and action row pinned. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/shell.css` | Shell styles: sliding root, dimmed chat, sky backdrop, tab strip, phone bar and mini bar. Layout follows the container, never the viewport. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/story.css` | Styles for the Story tab: plan bar, Director cards, agendas, secrets, ripples and trackers; tokens, plus the mock's fixed spoiler-button amber and white switch thumb. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/tokens.css` | The page-level colour tokens from SillyTavern's theme that the battle log, the Check card and NPC State's sheets read in the chat. | — | — | — | — |
| `ui/css/wizard.css` | New character wizard and first-send hold styles: the layout the sheets add to the Party sheet parts, the .ef fields and the kit buttons, in the mock's tokens. | — | — | — | — |

## Feature entry points

| Feature | Start reading at | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime start-up | `core/runtime.js` | Builds the host, registers modules and hooks chat events. |
| Prompt building | `core/prompt.js` | Assembles the static text and tail Story Block adds to each reply's prompt. |
| Reply capture | `core/capture.js` | Reads state changes out of a finished reply. |
| Saving and persistence | `core/persist.js` | Stores story state in the chat and its files. |
| Replay and rewind | `core/replay.js` | Rebuilds state from the chat after a swipe, edit or delete. |
| Commands | `core/commands.js` | The command registry every screen and module changes state through. |
| Module registry | `core/registry.js` | registerModule: how modules add parts, screens, widgets and queries. |
| Public API | `core/public-api.js` | The frozen read-only StoryBlock.api other extensions use. |
| Model calls | `core/model-call.js` | Helper model calls and their connection profile. |
| Pack events | `modules/world/events/condition.js` | Parses and safely evaluates pack-event conditions. |
| Module registration | `modules/director/module.js` | Registers Story Director's parts, screens and queries with Story Block. |
| Writes to story state | `modules/world/writes.js` | The commands that change what Story Director tracks. |
| Story arcs | `modules/arc/controller.js` | Browser-side arc planner and its draft, auto-accept and turn triggers. |
| Threads | `modules/time/tracker/threads.js` | Tracked story threads and their outcomes. |
| Map and places | `modules/atlas/atlas/map.js` | Builds the map widget props: places, routes, layers and discovery. |
| Cast | `modules/cast/cast/apply.js` | Applies cast sync, advance, meet, withdraw and rumor steps. |
| Chronicle | `modules/world/chronicle/index.js` | The running record of story days and what happened. |
| Time | `modules/time/index.js` | Story clock, days advancing and recaps. |
| Layouts and screens | `packs/layout/validate.js` | Screen layout definitions and their validation (the layout renderer went with the old view). |
| Packs | `packs/index.js` | Loads story packs and their events, items and rules. |
| Lean RPG (rolls, fights, gear) | `modules/rpg/index.js` | The optional RPG module: checks, the fight board, gear and levels. |
| Fight board | `modules/rpg/board/interaction.js` | The fight kind on the interaction port: code plays every fight on Combat Rules v1 and settles it as the reply's one guarded step. |
| Checks and danger | `modules/rpg/checks/index.js` | Story checks, danger words and rolls. |
| Data modules and block editor | `modules/data-modules/block-builder.js` | Builds and edits data-module definitions in the in-chat editor. |
| Extension entry | `core/boot/boot.js` | What SillyTavern loads: wires the v2 runtime, packs and diagnostics. |
